# smiit Analytics

> smiit Analytics is a data analytics platform by smiit GmbH (Ehingen, Baden-Württemberg, Germany). It consolidates a company's business data into one complete data model and delivers ready-made dashboards, 250+ pre-built analyses and AI-assisted analytics — for a one-time price, with full ownership and no vendor lock-in. The first supported source system is bexio.

Website: https://www.smiit-analytics.com
Languages: German (default at /de/), English (at /en/)
Contact: kontakt@smiit.de · +49 160 4073198
Vendor: smiit GmbH, Reiherweg 96, 89584 Ehingen, Germany
Founders / Managing directors: Sebastian Grab, Noah Neßlauer

## What smiit Analytics does

- Complete data model: all data from the connected source system integrated into one structured model
- Dashboarding: 250+ pre-built analyses across sales, accounting, orders and customers
- AI-ready foundation: the data model doubles as the infrastructure for add-ons and AI assistance
- Full ownership: one-time price, no recurring licence fees, no vendor lock-in
- Free 30-day trial before purchase

## Company

smiit GmbH builds custom software, data platforms and workflow automation for small and mid-sized enterprises. The main company website is https://www.smiit.de.
